title: MRS. J. W. BLAKEY
text:
MRS. J. W. BLAKEY

BELLS.—Mrs. J. W. Blakey, 58, of Bells, died at 4:48 a. m. Tuesday in a Sherman hospital following a lengthy illness.

Funeral services will be held at 2:30 p. m. Wednesday at the Bells Baptist Church. The Rev. Claud Johnston, pastor of the North Park Baptist Church of Sherman, and the Rev. Baxton Bryant, Bells pastor, will conduct. Burial will be in Oakhill Cemetery at Whitewright, directed by Earnheart Funeral Home.

Mrs. Blakey was born June 21, 1892, in Tennessee, a daughter of Mr. and Mrs. P. J. Russell. She was married to Mr. Blakey on Dec. 1, 1914, in Kentuckytown, and lived for 36 years near Whitewright. She was a member of the Baptist Church.

Survivors include her husband; one son, Tom Blakey of Mesquite; one daughter, Mrs. Rogers Holcomb, also of Mesquite; and three sisters, Mrs. Jack Lawrence of Sherman, Mrs. J. D. Young of Whitewright, and Mrs. Fred Howell of Dallas.
